Several weeks (1000 War Exp in repeatable missions) + ≈1 hour to climb the tower

To receive the {wiki:Insectoid Outfits|Insectoid Outfits} you have to do the missions of the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest} for {npc:Orockle} and help open the hive ({wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}). With enough War Exp you buy a pheromone, climb to the top of the Hive's west tower and use the {item:Insectoid Remains} to receive the outfit and addons, plus the achievement **Bane of the Hive**.
The Hive Born are threatening the world and have to be stopped.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 120+** (at the top of the west tower you face the strongest Hive Born).
300 War Exp for the outfit, 500 for the first addon and 1000 for the second addon.
50 Favour to buy the pheromone that gives access to the reward rooms.
The Hive must be open (phase 3 of the {wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born World Change}) for you to reach the reward room.
The quest items, given by {npc:Orockle} (see {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest})
War Exp is **not spent**: 1000 War Exp in total is enough for the full outfit (not 300 + 500 + 1000).
Phase 1 missions are worth 1 point (1 Favour and 1 War Exp); phase 2 missions are worth 2 points (2 Favour and 2 War Exp).
Check your War Exp and your Favour in the Quest Log.

Gray Beach is on the island of {wiki:Quirefang}, which can only be reached through {wiki:Gray Island}. Take a boat to Gray Island in **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron** (150 gp): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes}. On Gray Island go down the **only hole** on the island: an underground passage takes you to Quirefang. **Gray Beach** is the small village in the south of the island, with a depot and a temple underground.
Gray Island (the hole leads to Quirefang)

Go to **Gray Beach** and talk to {npc:Orockle}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. Accept and complete the missions of the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest} until you have the War Exp you need. Each mission also helps the server move the Hive on to the next phase.
Dissolved Chitin (8 vials to the hatchlings)
The step-by-step for each mission is in the War Against the Hive Quest guide.
Keep doing missions until you reach the value of the piece you want.
With at least **50 Favour**, say {key:hi}, {key:reward} and {key:yes} to {npc:Orockle}. You receive a pheromone that lasts **one week** and lets you pass the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates}.
You can only collect the reward once the Hive has started to open. If the pheromone runs out, you have to gather more Favour for another.

The {wiki:The Hive|Hive} is **north** of Gray Beach. The northern structure is split into two towers (east and west), each with 7 floors; the **west** tower only opens when the Hive is badly weakened (phase 3). In the {wiki:Hive|Hive}, take the **west** path, to the outfit tower.
Path to the outfit room — 1 (Hive entrance)
Go up the stairs to the **top floor** of the west tower. On the way you have to kill many of the stronger {wiki:Hive Born|Hive Born}.
The tower is full of the strongest Hive Born (in phase 3 there are {creature:Kollos} on every floor of the west structure). Go well supplied.
In the top room, use the {item:Insectoid Remains} on the floor, to the **southwest**. You receive the outfit and the addons your War Exp entitles you to, each with its own message.
Receiving the two addons at the Insectoid Remains
Insectoid Outfit + addons; Bane of the Hive achievement with the full outfit
You only receive the pieces your current War Exp entitles you to. For the rest, go back to the Remains when you have more War Exp (with the pheromone active).

You do not get stuck in the rooms behind the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates}: according to {npc:Orockle}, it is always possible to leave them. Go down the west tower by the same stairs and head back **south** to **Gray Beach**. To leave the island, take the underground passage in reverse to {wiki:Gray Island} and talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}).
It is also known as the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest|War Against the Hive Quest}.
The three messages at the Remains correspond, in order, to the base outfit, the first addon and the second addon.
